Android applies VPN app lists by UID. Selecting any of the apps below also selects the others because they share a UID.\n\n%1$s

Both TAP and TUN check the app and the destination. Traffic goes through the VPN only when it matches the rules here and in Address routing.

In Blocklist mode, selected apps use the underlying network. Other apps follow the VPN routes.

In Allowlist mode, only selected apps follow the VPN routes. Other apps use the underlying network. Select at least one eligible installed app.

In All apps mode, eligible apps follow the VPN routes. The same selections are saved for Blocklist and Allowlist modes.

The list applies to the current Android user or work profile. Apps that share a UID follow the same routes. The TAP app list also affects default DNS requests from apps. Android manages routing for critical system services. When using TUN, Android’s “Block connections without VPN” setting may restrict apps that use the underlying network.

Changes are saved automatically. Reconnect to apply them.
